# Key findings (auto-generated by `python/market_analysis.py`)

Historical observations from the data in this repository. They are not forecasts or investment advice.

- **Scale:** China produced 4,780 Mt in 2024 (67% of the five selected markets) and consumed 92.2 EJ (73% of selected consumption).
- **India:** production grew 5.3% a year and consumption 4.8% a year over 2014-2024; consumption rose 14.7% in 2024 alone.
- **Indonesia:** production CAGR 6.2%, consumption CAGR 11.5%; includes a +59% jump in 2023 that needs source verification.
- **Export dependence:** Indonesia exported 10.72 EJ in 2024 (2.3x its domestic consumption); Australia exported 9.07 EJ (6.0x its domestic consumption).
- **Import dependence (2024, imports / domestic consumption):** Japan 96%, India 23%, China 13%.
- **China's import pull:** imports rose 14.4% to 11.62 EJ and its share of world trade moved +3.6 pp to 32.3%.
- **Concentration:** the two exporters present in both years (Australia, Indonesia) supplied 55.0% of world trade in 2024 vs 53.6% in 2023; the four listed importers took 67.6% (vs 65.2%).
- **Price:** Australian thermal coal averaged $345/t in 2022 (peak), $108/t in 2025 (-69% vs peak, -22% vs 2021).
- **Contracting markets:** Australia (production -0.9%, consumption -2.2% CAGR) and Japan (consumption -1.1% CAGR) are shrinking domestically.
